decisions: Existing AES differential/managed checks expect managed.ll and obsolete managed.slg-tmp libraries; the compiled CSharp NativeOutputTransaction keeps managed.exe.ll. Existing CompilerLinkBridge consumes the compiled WindowsLinkPolicy and production WindowsLinker; use its verified proof explicitly instead of another entry name or manual link flags.

Unify the three duplicated AES checks behind the existing VerificationExecution supervisor, VerificationContractLease and artifact lifecycle. Keep their exact kernel/target/output checks, expose the same PowerShell commands, and pin the existing bridge proof. New outputs must be exclusive; never erase prior failed/cancelled products.

Source text.slg40-94 emits stable logical module groups, serial functions within a module, AES specialization before ordinary body, and parallelism only across modules. Replace three obsolete before/after-entry collection assertions with actual producer/consumer dispatch checks; test broken specialization and worker routing.

Stage2/3 and the benchmark must validate the explicit bridge proof before any expensive build, then forward it to the existing AES commands. Validation-only mode must not generate a bridge or compiler. Whole Stage gates remain unrun.

choice.rationale: Three existing scripts duplicate build/runtime checks and use stale linker ownership. A single small consumer of the existing supervisor, leases, cleanup and compiled linker removes the obsolete routes; no new linker or timeout increase.
